description: Full-text search (websearch syntax) of wiki.postgresql.org. By default searches each page's current text; history=true searches every revision and returns, per page, the latest matching revision (rev_id, revision_url, author, comment, timestamp, is_current) and how many matched; since/until bound the revision dates. Read a page with get_wiki_page; cite its wiki url. Search operators apply (intitle:, from:, after:/before:, link:, /regex/); operators, warnings and skipped report them.

history.description: Search every revision, not only the current text (default false)

since.description: With history: only revisions at or after this date (YYYY-MM-DD or ISO-8601)

until.description: With history: only revisions before the end of this date (YYYY-MM-DD or ISO-8601)

name: search_wiki
